It was so powerful that even the most pure-hearted exposed would gradually be swayed to ruthless ambition. After a horrible incident the tribes were forced to unite and fracture it, each secretly encasing a piece in stone such that no one person should know the location of all the fragments. This tribe buried their part in a tomb guarded by their spirit ancestor "Anastasia".
